title: Confirm Password not matching Password is rejected
preconditions: Anonymous user on the register page (bookcart environment)
steps: Fill First Name, Last Name, User Name with valid data
Enter "Different1" into the Confirm Password field
expected_result: Form is not submitted; the exact client-side message "Password do not match" is displayed under the Confirm Password field (verbatim, including the grammatical error - assert this exact string); no POST /api/user/ request fires.
